title: Recognising coins
examples: Teacher, which coin is worth more?
How many pennies do I need for a dime?
Can you show me a coin that is worth five?

explain.say: Today we are learning about coins. Coins are things we use for money. Different coins have different values.
Look at this coin. This is a penny. A penny is worth one unit of money. We can count it as one.
Next we see a two-unit coin. This coin is worth two units. You can count two pennies to make this coin.
Let us count three coins together. One, two, three. We have counted three units of money now.

faq.q: Why do we use coins for money?
faq.a: We use coins to buy things at the shop. They are a small way to trade for goods. You might also ask, 'What is money used for?' or 'Why do shops take coins?'

faq.q: Which coin is worth the most?
faq.a: The coin with the biggest number on it is worth the most. For example, a ten-unit coin is worth more than a one-unit coin. You could also ask, 'What is the highest value coin?'

faq.q: If I have two coins, how do I know the total?
faq.a: You count the values together. If one coin is two and another is one, you count two and then add one more. You could also ask, 'How do I add the coins?'
asks: How do I add the coins?
What is the total value of two coins?

faq.q: Are all coins the same shape?
faq.a: No, coins can have different shapes and sizes. Some are round, and some might have different edges. You might also ask, 'Do all coins look the same?'
asks: Do all coins look the same?

faq.q: Can I use a coin to count apples?
faq.a: No, coins are only for counting money. You use your fingers or blocks to count apples. You might also ask, 'Can I count fruit with coins?'
asks: Can I count fruit with coins?

facts: Coins are used as a form of money in many countries.
Each coin has a specific value that tells you how much it is worth.
To find the total value, you add the values of the coins together.
Some coins are bigger than others, showing a higher value.

quiz.say: Which coin is worth more, a five-unit coin or a one-unit coin?
quiz.why: Five is a bigger number than one, so the five-unit coin is worth more.

wrong.1: This is wrong because the numbers on the coins are different.
wrong.2: This is wrong because five is much bigger than one.
wrong.3: This is wrong because the value comes from the number, not the color.

quiz.say: To make a total of four units, what coins could you use?

options.show: Two two-unit coins and one one-unit coin
options.say: Two two-unit coins and one one-unit coin

options.show: One two-unit and one one-unit coin
options.say: One two-unit and one one-unit coin

quiz.why: You need to add up the values until you reach four, so two plus two works.

wrong.0: This is wrong because that would give you a total of five units.
wrong.2: This is wrong because two plus one only equals three units.
wrong.3: This is wrong because you need to use the fewest coins possible.
